intro.fallback: Joseph and Lisa Lisa head further into the hotel to defeat Kars and Wamuu.
The two see a blood trail and follow it to a door with a strange hand-shaped doorknob.
When JoJo grabs the doorknob, the door yells at him, claiming not to be a door.
